label: D2 after a2 reached S2 via common transition (earlier in episode, stronger when a2 is surprising)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the inputs show last action a2 and state S2 (a2 with a common transition). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, or after a rare transition. That conjunction alone has recall 1.0 and mass recall 1.0 but precision 0.36 (dev F1 0.53). It fires on only about a third of a2->S2 D2 steps. The rate falls steeply with episode position: peak around trials 30-50, near zero after trial 80. Adding ep_trial < 60 raises dev F1 to 0.65 with mass recall 0.83, so that is the recorded version. Magnitude and firing are higher when the a2 choice was unexpected: after a switch from a1, after an unrewarded previous trial, or when S1 is the good state (chose_good=0, rate 2x). Adding (prev_action != 2) | (prev_reward == 0) keeps 85% of activation mass on half the steps. It is mostly silent during long runs of rewarded a2->S2 trials. It also fires more when the value output is high (value > 8.1). It uses no future variables: action and state are inputs at D2.
